purpose: Model-development validation only; never the locked final test
rules: Annotations must be drawn or verified by a person and must not be copied from model predictions.
All images from one video or capture session remain in one split.
Negative images require a reviewed, empty YOLO label file.
Target distance strata must ultimately be defined by labelled target pixel size, not guessed physical range.
This validation set may guide development; it must not replace the untouched locked test.
